assets.caption: EXHIBIT 4-29 Grade-Mounted Centrifugal Compressor: No Shelter
assets.notes: Illustration of a grade-mounted centrifugal compressor with no shelter; shows a vertical cylindrical vessel (BOTTOM FLANGES), a horizontal compressor unit (ROTOR PULL), and a mobile crane on tracks (MOBILE HANDLING EQUIPMENT) on hatched ground. Caption block sits to the right of the illustration.
